newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hudson Foods up to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hudson Foods up to buy.

text.p: -- BT Securities analyst John O'Neil said Wednesday he raised his rating on Hudson Foods Inc to a buy from market performer.
-- He raised his fiscal 1997 estimate to $1.35 a share from $1.10. His estimate for fiscal 1996, ended in September, remains $0.56 a share.
-- O'Neil said he raised his rating and 1997 estimates to reflect lower corn prices.
-- Shares of Hudson Foods, a poultry producer and food processor, dropped 1/8 at 14-3/4.
